verdict.rationale: Reclaim ships Scheduling Links and Smart Meetings, so automatic conferencing on bookings is a fair axis for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions attaching a Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video link to bookings, and the scheduling-link docs cover only availability and priority-based rescheduling.

support.subject: As a founder, every booking gets a video conference link automatically (Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, or native video)
